recognize_zh: 組織切片中一顆巨大細胞，多個深染的核葉環狀排列、包圍中央淡粉紅細胞質，形成玫瑰花環（rosette）狀多核樣外觀，周圍為壞死碎屑與單核細胞；在急性骨髓單核球性白血病與複雜核型背景下屬怪異芽細胞型態。
features: Single giant cell with approximately six dark nuclear lobes arranged in a ring around a central pale eosinophilic cytoplasmic core (rosette/floret-like)
Nuclear lobes hyperchromatic with coarse chromatin; outer rim of abundant finely granular/vacuolated gray-lilac cytoplasm
Surrounding smaller mononuclear cells, some with folded nuclei and granular cytoplasm, admixed with red cells
Background of loose fibrinous/proteinaceous material and degenerating cells
Section thickness and degeneration limit fine nuclear detail
describe_en: Section shows a loosely cellular infiltrate of mononuclear cells with folded nuclei in a background of fibrinous material and cellular debris. A conspicuous giant cell has multiple hyperchromatic nuclear lobes arranged circumferentially around a central core of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, producing a rosette-like multinucleated appearance, with an outer rim of granular cytoplasm. This bizarre blast morphology has been described in AML with complex cytogenetic abnormalities and should not be mistaken for a megakaryocyte or metastatic tumor giant cell. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia (myelomonocytic) with rosette-like multinucleated blasts; immunohistochemistry (CD34, MPO, lysozyme, CD61) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with connected lobes and abundant pink granular cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive, unlike this myeloid/monocytic marker-positive blast.

ddx.dx: Floret-type multinucleated giant cells (e.g., pleomorphic lipoma, giant cell fibroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Floret cells occur in soft tissue tumors with stromal context, not in a leukemic infiltrate, and lack myeloid markers.
Osteoclasts have many separate, uniform, round nuclei scattered in cytoplasm next to bone, rather than lobes arranged in a ring.
Reed-Sternberg cells have large inclusion-like nucleoli and CD30/CD15 positivity, while hallmark cells are CD30+/ALK+ with horseshoe nuclei.
